title: Tim Knight Says Nothing's Broken for the Bears, the Market Just Won't Fall
speaker: Tim Knight

macro_themes.view: Repeated bogus Iran peace-deal rumors keep goosing the market higher; he expects that to abate after the elections in nine trading days.
Big names like GE and GM are falling ~20% from peaks and tech keeps making lower highs, yet indexes won't break.
Since 2009 the market has been an 'everything bubble' with ever-shorter drops; AI is either the economy's savior or the biggest financial catastrophe ever.

calls.condition: Needs ES to break ~7,670 for meaningful bearish action
calls.reason: SPY remains below its broken trend line (from the March war bottom) and below gaps, with no follow-through after Oct 6 lifetime highs; 'nothing's broken' for bears though the market just won't fall.
calls.quote: for all my belly aching, nothing's really broken from the bearish side. The trend lines have still failed.

calls.condition: Needs NQ below the key 'blue line' support to see broad selling
calls.reason: Every day since the lifetime high QQQ and XLK have made a lower high and stay below the broken trend line, showing internal weakness.
calls.quote: Every single day a lower high... it is telling to me that the the peak each day has failed to to uh beat the peak of the day prior.

calls.condition: If SMH breaks 536, 'something's really cooking' to the downside
calls.reason: Semis in a descending channel and near major support that has held repeatedly; a break would trigger real selling but it may not happen soon.
calls.quote: It has got to break 536 to get some real selling going.

calls.reason: Nice long-term bearish pattern in China ETF; holding a short with a tight stop just above yesterday's high (~$34).
South Korea turned south as predicted; covered the short for a profit but the price gap is intact and the pattern could still work lower.
calls.quote: It's not a badl looking pattern. It could still certainly work its way lower.

calls.condition: Bearish setup only ruined if XLU pushes past the overhead horizontal
calls.reason: Utilities dropped 2%+ yesterday; still below recent highs on an inside day; one of only three ETF shorts he holds.
calls.quote: Nothing's broken. I mean, it won't really get ruined unless we push past um that horizontal right there.

calls.reason: Gold has been stuck for weeks and could keep slumping toward $4,000/oz, though it hasn't broken down and he hasn't lost faith.
calls.quote: GLD is down half a percent. And it could just keep slumping toward $4,000 an ounce.

calls.condition: Needs to clear first horizontal, then the higher horizontal/trend line
calls.reason: Silver bouncing but hasn't reached its first goal; not broken down and he still has faith in metals.
calls.quote: I haven't really lost faith in either of them, but they really got to, you know, take their vitamins

calls.reason: Down from ~$233 peak to ~$76; he keeps tightening the stop and hopes it grinds to the next support (green dashed line).
calls.quote: I've just I'm tightening tightening tightening the stop all along the way.

calls.reason: Down nearly 80% from >$50 peak to low teens and working below its red stop line; still short.
calls.quote: So, its loss is approaching 80%. But I'm still shorted.

calls.reason: Consistent sawtooth/sine-wave pattern; short with stop just above yesterday's high.
calls.quote: the stop on this one is just above yesterday's high.

calls.reason: Near lifetime lows with a head-and-shoulders top; not afraid to short stocks at the bottom of the screen.
calls.quote: It's got a beautiful head and shoulders. We'll just use the word top.

calls.reason: Inclined to think Tesla drops after earnings tomorrow, but has no position.
calls.quote: I'm kind of inclined to think it's going to drop tomorrow, but I'm not putting my money where my mouth is.

calls.reason: SpaceX has whittled down to a ~$150 anchor and the space ETF (UFO) looks bearish; he expects a drop to low 140s/upper 130s after earnings despite being a long-term bull.
calls.quote: I'm kind of think it's probably going to drop. um maybe lower 140s, upper 130s

notes: Host says 'Today is Tuesday' with nine trading days to the election -> 2026-10-20. Positioned ~120% net short across 25 small shorts. An ETF short ticker garbled as 'EW' (symmetric triangle, stop 76.5) was skipped as unidentifiable. 'SPACEX' ticker is a placeholder; SpaceX trading symbol not stated. SpaceX 150 is his anchor level, not necessarily the live price.
